content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect to [product_name] through the web with multiple sessions? Currently, using the same user account, the latest login will disconnect the previous one, so only one session is allowed at a time. Is there a way to create additional users or a workaround for this? Thank you.

Have you tested this with the web server? I registered two devices on the basic web server—first a tablet, then a PC: On both, the [product_name] display and the operator panel display did not show correctly; there were no cursor or function keys visible. Testing with the extended web server, first using the tablet and then the PC: On the tablet, the interface and controls appeared and worked as expected. On the PC, however, some buttons and graphic elements were not displayed, and clicking on those areas sometimes triggered actions and sometimes did not.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers around restrictions of the web editor for [product_name], specifically regarding multiple simultaneous web sessions. Using the same user account limits access to one active session, where logging in from another device will close the previous session. Tests reveal that user interface elements may not display or function consistently across devices when trying to access the application from several devices at the same time.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to operate the web interface over multiple devices simultaneously, either by enabling more user logins or finding a workaround that allows concurrent sessions without impacting functionality or display.
